profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a Miami, Florida based public company, traded under the ticker HUT, that describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses which acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. In its own words, the portfolio is meant to give direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

The company's site highlights the full commercialization of its 1 GW Beacon Point AI data center campus, citing a second 352 MW IT lease and stating that this brings campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 Billion. No individual products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are listed.

On the legal side, the held facts record Florida as a jurisdiction of exposure with a count of 96, while listing no individual cases. The profile also carries a CIK of 0001964789 and identifies the company as a for-profit public company.
